brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Tidy storage for sewing supplies - organized containers to keep notions separated
requirements.evidence: 3-cell build with 2x full-depth 2-compartment bins (bin:0,0,0 and bin:0,1,0) plus half bin (bin:1,0,0) provides 5 compartments total. Props present: heap-screws/nuts as stand-ins for buttons/beads, tape-electrical as thread/binding stand-in. No dedicated sewing props (scissors, thread spools, fabric) exist in catalog.
3 pieces in L-shape, ~381 x 338 mm approx, 18 parts total, capped and joint-bolted.

finish.summary: L-shaped 3-cell sewing caddy with 5 divided compartments for small notions. Staged with small-parts props as button/thread analogues - dedicated sewing props are not available in the prop library, so function is shown by compartmentalized bins.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
